name: cleides-fotografia
description: Site e painel administrativo da Cleides Dias Fotografia

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cleides/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @cleides/backend" "npm run dev -w @cleides/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cleides/shared && npm run build -w @cleides/backend && npm run build -w @cleides/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @cleides/shared && npm run build -w @cleides/backend
